designationHistory.indexText: Toppenish National Wildlife Refuge in Washington's Yakima Valley was established in 1964 with the purchase of the 40-acre Cloe Tract, after the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission authorized it on August 21, 1962.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Aug. 21, 1962); first purchase 1964

sources.name: FWS, Toppenish NWR Inventory and Monitoring Plan (2020)
